title: NoAI and extended beacon range
description: A simple server sidded mod which removes villager ai when named with a "NoAI" nametag, and beacon range extended to 150 blocks
body:
A way to minize **lag from villagers** by disabling their ai with a nametag. Simply give them the name "NoAI" (without parenthesis).

This mod also **extends the beacon** range from the default 50 blocks to a **whopping 150!**

_This mod was made for a private SMP, but since others might also find this usefull I've decided to publish it. Cheers!_
